description: Ed25519 over canonical JSON (RFC 8785): device-signed requests, provisioning registrations (management + content key), update assignments. Development keys only. `canonical` checks JCS parity (integers only). `ed25519`: strict verification (`expect`); `laxAccepts` records whether cofactorless verification without the key checks (Go crypto/ed25519 alone) would accept.
